fault_confinement_states.name: error active
fault_confinement_states.description: ECR.TEC < 128 AND ECR.REC < 128. Can take part in bus communication; sends ACTIVE ERROR FLAG (6 dominant bits) on error.

fault_confinement_states.name: error passive
fault_confinement_states.description: ECR.TEC ≥ 128 OR ECR.REC ≥ 128. PSR.EP = 1. Sends PASSIVE ERROR FLAG (6 recessive bits); must wait SUSPEND TRANSMISSION (8 recessive bits) before initiating further transmission. In CAN FD, ESI in transmitted FD frame must be recessive.

fault_confinement_states.name: bus off
fault_confinement_states.description: ECR.TEC = 256. PSR.BO = 1; output drivers off; no influence on bus. Recovers to error-active after 129 occurrences of Bus_Idle (129 × 11 consecutive recessive bits) after CCCR.INIT is cleared by the CPU. Once Bus_Off is reached, CCCR.INIT is set automatically by the M_CAN.

operational_modes_fsm.name: RESET
operational_modes_fsm.description: Hardware reset. CCCR = 0x0001 (INIT = 1). m_can_tx = recessive. All EML counters unchanged.

operational_modes_fsm.name: INIT_SW
operational_modes_fsm.description: CCCR.INIT = 1 (any source: reset, ECC uncorrected, BO entry, or CPU). Bus transfer stopped. Configuration registers writable when CCCR.CCE also = 1.

operational_modes_fsm.name: NORMAL
operational_modes_fsm.description: CCCR.INIT cleared by CPU. Bit Stream Processor (BSP) waits for 11 consecutive recessive bits (Bus_Idle) then joins bus.

operational_modes_fsm.name: CAN_FD_OP
operational_modes_fsm.description: CCCR.FDOE = 1; FD-capable Tx Buffer elements (FDF = 1) transmit in CAN FD format. If CCCR.BRSE = 1 + Tx Buffer BRS = 1, data phase switches to DBTP rate.

operational_modes_fsm.name: BUS_MONITORING
operational_modes_fsm.description: CCCR.MON = 1. Receives valid frames + remote frames; cannot transmit dominant bits — replaces internally; TXBRP held in reset.

operational_modes_fsm.name: RESTRICTED_OP
operational_modes_fsm.description: CCCR.ASM = 1. Receives data + remote frames + sends ACK to valid frames; does NOT send data/remote/active-error/overload frames. Entered automatically on Tx Handler RAM access failure.

operational_modes_fsm.name: DAR
operational_modes_fsm.description: CCCR.DAR = 1. No automatic retransmission for messages lost or disturbed.

operational_modes_fsm.name: SLEEP_REQ
operational_modes_fsm.description: m_can_clkstop_req or CCCR.CSR = 1. M_CAN waits for pending Tx complete + bus idle.

operational_modes_fsm.name: SLEEP_ACK
operational_modes_fsm.description: CCCR.INIT set + m_can_clkstop_ack + CCCR.CSA = 1. m_can_hclk + m_can_cclk may be stopped. CCCR.INIT held at 1; further register access allowed except for CCCR.INIT.

operational_modes_fsm.name: TEST_LBCK_EXT
operational_modes_fsm.description: TEST.LBCK = 1, CCCR.MON = 0. Tx looped back to Rx; ACK errors ignored.

operational_modes_fsm.name: TEST_LBCK_INT
operational_modes_fsm.description: TEST.LBCK = 1, CCCR.MON = 1. m_can_rx disconnected; m_can_tx forced recessive.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_BUS_IDLE
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Wait for Bus_Idle (≥ 11 consecutive recessive bits).

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_SOF
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Drive START OF FRAME (1 dominant); all nodes hard-synchronize.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_ARBITRATION
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Send IDENTIFIER + RTR (Classical) or RRS (FD); monitor bus. Recessive driven + dominant monitored → LOSE arbitration → switch to receiver.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_CONTROL_FD
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: (FD) Send r1, FDF=1, res=0, BRS, ESI, DLC[3:0]. At BRS=1 bit: switch to DBTP rate from BRS to CRC delimiter.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_DATA
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Send DATA FIELD (0..64 bytes per DLC encoding; FD payload up to 64 B).

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_STUFF_CNT
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: (FD/ISO only) Send 3-bit stuff-count + 1-bit parity before CRC sequence.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_CRC
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Send CRC SEQUENCE (15 / 17 / 21 bit depending on format + payload) + recessive CRC DELIMITER.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_BRS_OFF
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: (FD with BRS=1) At CRC delimiter: switch back to NBTP rate.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_ACK_SLOT
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Drive recessive on ACK SLOT; sample bus; expect a dominant ACK from at least one receiver. In FD, ACK timing accounts for transmitter delay.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_EOF
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Drive 7 recessive bits as END OF FRAME.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_SUSPEND
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: (error-passive only) Drive 8 recessive SUSPEND TRANSMISSION bits.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_PAUSE
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: (CCCR.TXP=1) Wait 2 additional CAN bit times before initiating next own transmission.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_BUS_IDLE
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Wait for dominant bit (= START OF FRAME) on m_can_rx.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_HARD_SYNC
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Hard-synchronize internal bit time to SOF edge. If CCCR.EFBI = 1, require 2 consecutive dominant tq for edge.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_ARBITRATION
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Sample IDENTIFIER + RTR/RRS + IDE + extended bits; apply acceptance filtering on completed ID.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_FDF_DETECT
fsm_hints_receiver.description: At FDF bit position: dominant → Classical receiver path; recessive → FD receiver path. If FDF=1 + res=1 (or in protocol-exception window): protocol exception → PSR.PXE + integrating.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_BRS_DETECT
fsm_hints_receiver.description: (FD only) At BRS bit: if BRS=1, switch to DBTP bit time + use SSP for bit error check in data phase.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_DATA_COLLECT
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Receive DATA FIELD per DLC encoding; resynchronize on each recessive→dominant transition (subject to NSJW / DSJW).

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_CRC_CHECK
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Compute CRC (15-bit / 17-bit / 21-bit per format + payload size); compare with received CRC sequence + stuff count parity (ISO).

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_ACK_GEN
fsm_hints_receiver.description: If CRC matched, drive dominant during ACK SLOT.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_VALIDATE
fsm_hints_receiver.description: If no error up to the last-but-one bit of EOF, message is valid; pass via Acceptance Filter → Rx Buffer / Rx FIFO; set IR.RFnN / IR.DRX.

synchronization_rules: Only one SYNCHRONIZATION within one bit time is allowed.
An edge is used for SYNCHRONIZATION only if the value detected at the previous SAMPLE POINT differs from the bus value immediately after the edge.
HARD SYNCHRONIZATION is performed on the recessive-to-dominant edge during BUS IDLE (= START OF FRAME).
RESYNCHRONIZATION jump width: NSJW[6:0]+1 tq in arbitration phase; DSJW[3:0]+1 tq in data phase.
Edge filtering during bus integration: CCCR.EFBI = 1 requires 2 consecutive dominant tq to detect an edge for hard sync.
Information Processing Time (IPT) is zero in M_CAN — bit value available at first clock edge after sample point.
In CAN FD data phase the bit error check uses the Secondary Sample Point (SSP) when TDC is enabled.
arbitration_rule: Bitwise on ARBITRATION FIELD (IDENTIFIER + RTR/RRS). Each transmitter compares its driven bit to the monitored bus level. Recessive driven + dominant monitored → arbitration lost; transmitter withdraws and may retry when bus is idle. M_CAN's Tx Handler scans all Tx Buffers + selects the message with lowest IDENTIFIER (= highest priority) before each tx slot; lost arbitration → automatic retry (unless CCCR.DAR = 1).
anti_deadlock_rule: Multimaster arbitration is non-blocking — winner continues; losers become receivers. Fault confinement (error-passive / bus-off) prevents a single defective node from blocking the bus. M_CAN's transmit pause (CCCR.TXP = 1) further smooths out burst transmissions to prevent one ECU dominating arbitration.
exit_from_reset_or_wakeup: After hardware reset CCCR.INIT = 1, m_can_tx = recessive. After CPU clears CCCR.INIT, the Bit Stream Processor waits for 11 consecutive recessive bits (= Bus_Idle) before joining bus activities. From Sleep Mode: deassert m_can_clkstop_req; M_CAN resets m_can_clkstop_ack + CCCR.CSA; CPU resets CCCR.INIT to enter normal operation.
default_signal_state_when_bus_free: Bus idle = all nodes drive recessive (= released). The M_CAN's m_can_tx is held recessive (HIGH) under CCCR.INIT = 1.
wake_up_message_identifier: CAN FD itself does not define a wake-up identifier at the protocol layer (it is a Classical-CAN convention 'rrr rrrd rrrr' = lowest possible priority). M_CAN's clock-stop power-down mechanism is bus-activity agnostic at the protocol layer — wake-up is driven by m_can_clkstop_req deasserting.
protected_write_unlock_sequence: 3. Write configuration registers (DBTP, NBTP, TDCR, GFC, SIDFC, XIDFC, XIDAM, RXF0C, RXBC, RXF1C, RXESC, TXBC, TXESC, TXEFC, TSCC, TOCC).
5. Clear CCCR.INIT — wait for INIT to read back 0 before any operation; due to clock-domain crossing there is a delay.
cccr_init_self_set_conditions: Uncorrected bit error read from Message RAM (IR.BEU = 1).
Power-down mode (m_can_clkstop_req or CCCR.CSR = 1) after pending Tx complete + bus idle.
fault_confinement_counter_rules: Receive Error Counter increments on receive errors per ISO 11898-1:2015 Section 12 (typically +1 for general RX error, +8 for dominant after error flag).
Transmit Error Counter increments on transmit errors (typically +8 for own error flag transmission).
TEC stops at 0xFF; REC stops at 0x7F.
When CCCR.ASM (Restricted Operation Mode) set: TEC + REC are frozen but CEL (Error Logging Counter) continues incrementing.
ECR.RP = 1 reflects RX-side error passive (REC ≥ 128). PSR.EP = 1 reflects either-side error passive (TEC ≥ 128 OR REC ≥ 128).

CEL[7:0] = CAN Error Logging Counter: 8-bit counter incrementing once per CAN protocol error that incremented TEC/REC, plus once on Bus_Off entry. Reset on read of byte 2 (RX) of ECR. Overflow → IR.ELO.
rx_handler_state_machine: Acceptance Filter: applied after complete identifier received; sequential filter list scan; first matching enabled element wins.
Storage: per matched filter element's SFEC/EFEC: FIFO 0 / FIFO 1 / dedicated Rx Buffer / debug message A-C / reject / set-priority(HPM).
Rx FIFO Put Index advanced on store; if FIFO full + blocking mode: discard new message + IR.RFnL.
Rx FIFO Put Index advanced on store; if FIFO full + overwrite mode: overwrite oldest + put/get indices both advance.
Dedicated Rx Buffer locked by New Data flag until host clears NDAT bit.
Sync message (filter SSYNC/ESYNC = 1 + CCCR.UTSU = 1) generates pulse at m_can_tsrx independent of storage.
Filter event pin pulse generated per SFID2[8:6] / EFID2[8:6] on match.
tx_handler_state_machine: Tx Scan: triggered when TXBRP register changes (TX done / cancellation / Host TXBAR write). Identifies up to 2 highest-priority pending Tx requests.
Preload: first 4 RAM words of top 1-2 pending messages loaded into internal temporary buffers.
Tx Slot: at next bus opportunity, send the highest-priority preloaded message; in DAR mode, no retransmission.
Tx FIFO: messages transmitted in put-order (per FIFO Get Index).
Tx Queue: messages transmitted by lowest Message ID (Tx Buffer with lowest ID wins).
Mixed Dedicated + FIFO / Queue: dedicated buffers + FIFO/Queue both scanned; lowest ID wins.
Tx Cancellation: TXBCR bit set → cancel buffer; success → TXBCF bit set + TXBRP cleared.
Tx Event FIFO write: on successful transmission (or successful-in-spite-of-cancellation in DAR mode), if Tx Buffer T1.EFC = 1, write Message ID + Timestamp + Message Marker + ET to Tx Event FIFO.
